name: Arena
description: Draj's gladiatorial arena. Red brick walls sand floor surrounded by crowds.

name: Slave Pens
description: Maze of brown brick rooms. Big fountain south. Gladiator pens east monster pens west.

name: Sewers
description: Maze of tunnels beneath Draj inhabited by Tari rat-people.

name: Dagolar's Tunnels
description: Hidden tunnels where Dagolar 20th-level psionicist conducts experiments.

name: Fields
description: Sandy wastes between Draj and the free villages. Drajian patrols.

name: White Sands
description: Sandy waste between Fields and Teaquetzl. Final battles vs Drajian army.

name: Teaquetzl Village
description: Free village in middle of sandy wastes. Founded by escaped slaves.

name: Nazca Lines
description: Sandy wasteland.

name: Cedrilte Village
description: Free village. Strangers mistrusted. Won't ally until threats resolved.

name: Undermountain
description: Subterranean region home of Undermountain Folk Mindhome.

name: Lower Castle
description: Wyvern riders operate from here raiding the Elven Caravan.

name: Upper Castle
description: Upper levels of the castle.

name: Salt Oasis
description: Salt flats with springs. Templar mining for copper with slave labor.

name: Hot Springs
description: Salt flat springs being mined for copper by a Drajian templar.

name: Gedron Village
description: Taken over by evil defiler Wyrmias who controls villagers' minds.

name: Silt Sea Ssurrans
description: Isthmus into Silt Sea. Ssurran slave traders hold one statue piece.

name: Silt Sea Summoning
description: Site of summoning ritual. Jasmine 9th-level preserver. Arant holds gladiators.

name: Captured Gladiators
description: Gladiators from Gedron and Cedrilte captured by Arant.

name: Palace Ruins (Korbnor)
description: Buried ancient city. Korbnor was beautiful before being buried in sandstorm. Cragg Genie psurlons.

name: Lava Rift
description: Rift to elemental plane of fire. Hermit defiler summons elementals.

name: Gemfields
description: Lava flows. Geysers. Lava domes contain gems. Thri-kreen hunters.

name: Wagon Train
description: Small plateaus and sinkholes. Magera attacked wagon train. Bridge over chasm.

name: Red Sands Plateau
description: Large central mesa. Common wandering monsters.

name: Sand Oasis
description: Sand druid watches over oasis. Ensures it is not defiled.

name: Elven Slavers
description: Templar and slavers operate here. Templar has whistle to summon troops.

name: Messenger Route
description: White sand deserts. Slavers messenger blue slaad.

name: Elven Caravan
description: Sits in sandy wastes. Bone fence. Burrowing fire eels and bulettes attack.

name: Ssurran Ruins
description: Ssurran tribe worshipping old ruins and spirits.

name: Wyrm Belly
description: Inside a massive wyrm. Magera raiders.

name: Wyrm School
description: Connected wyrm region. Balkazar receives terror extract from Notaku.

name: Wyrm Temple
description: Connected wyrm region.

name: Subterranean Temple
description: Reached via rope on Wagon Train bridge or wells in villages.

name: The Freelands
description: New chapter. Desert beyond Draj's reach. Nomads and escaped slaves.

name: Shattered Spire
description: New chapter. Ruined pre-cataclysm tower six levels deep.
